mapper.select: select c.coach_idx, u.user_name, c.nickname, c.phone, u.created_at, u.status, (select count(*) from cert c_sub where c_sub.users_idx = c.users_idx and cert_status = '대기') as cert_wait_count from coach c join users u on c.users_idx = u.users_idx order by u.created_at desc
select count(*) from cert where cert_type = '자격증' and cert_status = '대기'
